disclaimer: Research and paper trading only. sollab does not place live orders, sign wallets, create tokens, or use brokerage credentials.

account_rules.summary: Shared paper cash stays 5000 USD and the per-position cap stays 10 USD. One open position per market now includes metals. Long and short are allowed. A metals short accrues a paper borrow rate; earlier books are not rewritten.

parameters.metals_short_borrow_note: Research assumption, actual/365 on entry notional. Not a live borrow quote. Crypto and pump.fun books keep borrow_apr at 0.

shared_account.note: Current paper account starts at 5000 USD under account_rules 4.0.0. Open positions, locked notional, and P&L add every cash_era 5000 forward book, including the latest pump.fun book. Train, validation, and cash_era 300 stay out of these totals.
